summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the brand-slug backfill fix (SHOP/BRANDS dropdowns). Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_catalog_brands.py (16 tests) + updated test_sitemap_urlonly.py (11 tests) -> 27/27 passing. GET /api/products returns exactly 67 products, every product now has a non-empty kebab-case `brand` slug, 35 distinct brand slugs, 7 distinct categorySlug, no _id leak; brandName set matches the 35 expected brands exactly. Sitemap (/sitemap.xml static and /api/sitemap.xml) = 200 application/xml, valid urlset, 114 unique <url> each with loc+lastmod, all https://puff2door.com/, split 5 static + 7 /product-category + 35 /brand + 67 /shop, brand slugs identical to product brand slugs, no image tags, no external hosts, no query strings, no cart/checkout/admin/account/wishlist/track/order URLs; both copies identical; robots.txt 200 with 'Sitemap: https://puff2door.com/sitemap.xml'. Frontend desktop 1920: Shop dropdown shows exactly the 7 expected categories (nav-cat-*), Brands dropdown shows exactly 35 brands alphabetically (nav-brand-*) matching the expected list. All 7 category pages: correct h1 + banner 'N products available' == backend count == rendered card count. 8 brand pages (muha, twenty-one, glass-tobacco-pipe, geek-bar, raz, silly-dots, wild-hemp, apex): correct h1, counts match backend, cards rendered, title '<Brand> Products Online | Puff2door'. /brands grid = 35 tiles, logo-less tiles show name + 'N products', tile click navigates. Home 'Shop By Brand' = 16 tiles with text fallback, navigates to brand page. Mobile 390x844: hamburger -> 7 mobile-cat-*, mobile-brands <details> summary -> 35 mobile-brand-*, brand and category clicks navigate and close the menu. Regression: PDP /shop/muha-cartridge-1g-hybrid-apple-gelato-ice-31 loads with breadcrumb + Organization/WebSite/Product/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, add-to-cart increments header cart count to 1, home title 'Online Smoke Shop & Vape Delivery | Puff2door', footer shows 7 category links.

Recommend restoring product 16's description.
Still returns X-Robots-Tag: noindex (carried over from iteration 7; harmless for the non-canonical API copy).

Optional: drop X-Robots-Tag: noindex on GET /api/sitemap.xml.
Redeploy so production serves the 114-URL sitemap (preview verified).
critical_code_review_comments: brand_slug() falls back to slugify(name.split(' ')[0]) when both brand and brandName are empty — this can silently mint junk brand pages/sitemap URLs from a product's first word. Consider omitting the brand instead of guessing, or enforce brandName at write time in ProductInput.

CatalogContext derives brands/categories client-side from the full /api/products payload; fine at 67 products but will not scale if the catalog grows or /api/products becomes paginated — a /api/facets (categories+brands with counts) endpoint would be safer.

The stored `brand` field remains empty for 59/67 products; the slug exists only in the API projection, so any consumer reading Mongo directly (admin filters, future queries) still sees blanks. A one-time backfill migration would remove the divergence.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested desktop, mobile and regression flows passed)

No regressions found.
